audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that require PDF document processing, including those targeting .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0, or .NET 8+.

capabilities.text: Create new PDFs or open existing ones, add/delete/reorder pages, and preserve bookmarks, outlines, page labels, named destinations, XMP metadata, and optional content layers on save.
capabilities.title: Document creation and manipulation

capabilities.text: Extract text with absorbers, build new text with fragments and segments, support Bidi/RTL, ligatures, and AGL Unicode mapping, and perform find-and-replace across pages.
capabilities.title: Text handling and extraction

capabilities.text: Read, fill, and flatten AcroForm fields including text, checkbox, radio, choice, button, signature, date, rich text, file-select, and barcode fields; export/import form data as JSON or XFDF.
capabilities.title: Form processing

capabilities.text: Render pages to PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, or SVG using pluggable IPageRenderer; extract vector graphics to SVG with SvgExtractor.
capabilities.title: Rendering and export

capabilities.text: Encrypt with RC4-40/128 and AES-128/256; sign with PKCS#1 and PKCS#7/CMS detached signatures including DocMDP, RFC 3161 timestamps, and external signing callbacks.
capabilities.title: Security and signing

capabilities.text: Build or inspect tagged content structure, set language and alternate text, and auto-tag documents for PDF/UA-1 compliance using AutoTaggingSettings.
capabilities.title: Accessibility and tagging

capabilities.text: Compare documents visually or structurally, detect forged signatures with SignaturesCompromiseDetector, and sanitize content with HiddenDataSanitizer.
capabilities.title: Comparison and validation

capabilities.text: Use task-oriented facades like PdfFileEditor, PdfBookmarkEditor, PdfContentEditor, PdfFileStamp, and PdfFileSanitization for common workflows.
capabilities.title: Facades and high-level tools

limitations.text: Members that accept or return System.Drawing images (e.g., ImageDevice.GetBitmap, StampInfo.Image) are Windows-only and throw PlatformNotSupportedException on Linux/macOS.
PdfViewer printing works only on Windows with an installed printer; print-to-file with .pdf target bypasses this requirement.
OCSP and CRL revocation checks are not implemented; ValidationOptions.ValidationMethod for these reports undefined results.
DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() is not implemented and throws NotImplementedException.
Rendering is not pixel-identical across platforms due to differences between GDI+ and managed renderers.
Auto-tagging infers structure from layout and may require manual correction for unusual documents.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, editing, and conversion without requiring Adobe Acrobat or other proprietary software.
Supports common PDF tasks such as form filling, annotation management, text extraction, and document security through a unified object model.
Provides accessibility compliance via tagged PDF support and automatic structure inference for PDF/UA-1 conversion.
Facilitates document comparison and validation with side-by-side, text-based, and graphical comparison tools.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF.FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET library for reading, creating, modifying, and converting PDF documents across .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0, and .NET 8+ runtimes.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() when called is not specified beyond throwing NotImplementedException.
Whether PdfViewer supports printing to non-default printers beyond the default printer's settings is unclear.
The scope of XFA field authoring limitations beyond high-level operations is not detailed.
The exact behavior of PDF3DAnnotation rendering and regeneration on save is not fully specified.
Whether the managed renderer supports all shading types mentioned (mesh types 4-7) is not explicitly confirmed.
The exact behavior of side-by-side comparison when text is identical but layout differs is implied but not explicitly stated.
Whether all public symbols listed (983 types) are fully implemented across all targets is not confirmed.
The exact behavior of PDF/A conversion when content cannot be repaired (e.g., missing glyphs) is limited to logging rather than fixing.

workflows.name: Create and save PDF
workflows.text: Create a new PDF document using the Document class, add pages, insert text or images, and save to file or stream.

workflows.name: Extract text and forms
workflows.text: Use TextAbsorber, TextFragmentAbsorber, or TableAbsorber to extract content; use Form to read or fill interactive form fields.

workflows.name: Apply security and signing
workflows.text: Encrypt documents using RC4 or AES, sign with PKCS#1 or PKCS#7 signatures, and verify signatures using ValidationOptions.

workflows.name: Convert between formats
workflows.text: Load HTML, Markdown, SVG, TXT, PS, or XML files into PDF, or export to HTML, SVG, Markdown, or PDF/A and PDF/UA formats.

workflows.name: Stamp and annotate
workflows.text: Add text, image, or page-number stamps; insert link, text, highlight, redaction, and other annotation types with appearance control.

workflows.name: Compare documents
workflows.text: Use SideBySidePdfComparer, TextPdfComparer, or GraphicalPdfComparer to generate visual or structured differences between documents.
